name: explore_plan_build
title: Explore -> Plan -> Approve -> Build -> Verify
description: Explore the codebase, produce a structured task_list.v1 plan, pause at a human/coordinator gate, then fan out across planned items and run a final integration verification.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.description: High-level objective for the feature or change

inputs.name: verify_cmd
inputs.description: Verification command to run on each built item and final integration

brief.goal: Explore the codebase and identify key files, constraints, and risks for: {{inputs.goal}}
acceptance: Summary of relevant modules, entry points, and risks submitted as JSON output

brief.goal: Based on exploration ({{stage.explore.output.summary}}), decompose '{{inputs.goal}}' into concrete, verifiable work items.
acceptance: Structured task_list.v1 output with non-empty goal, acceptance, and verify per item

gate.prompt: Approve the generated plan ({{stage.plan.output.summary}}) before building?

acceptance: Implementation complete and verification passes for {{item.key}}

brief.goal: Run full integration verification across all built items for: {{inputs.goal}}
acceptance: Full verification command exits 0 and all changes integrate cleanly
